description_en: Configures IP Application Acceleration (IPA) for multiple domain names in a single operation
description_zh: 调用BatchSetDcdnIpaDomainConfigs批量配置IPA层应用加速域名
name: BatchSetDcdnIpaDomainConfigs

parameters.help_en:
The domain names to configure for IPA. Separate multiple domain names with a comma (,).

You can specify a maximum of 20 domain names
parameters.help_zh:
IPA层应用加速域名，多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔。
一次最多传20个域名
parameters.name: domain_names

parameters.help_en: The functions to configure, specified as a JSON string. Format: `[{"functionArgs":[{"argName":"Configuration Name","argValue":"Configuration Value"}],"functionName":"Function Name"}]`
parameters.help_zh: 功能列表。```[{"functionArgs":[{"argName":"配置名称","argValue":"配置值"}],"functionName":"功能名称"}]```
parameters.name: functions

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request
